text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan
(Aktiviti Digalakkan dan Keluaran Digalakkan bagi Pelaburan Semula) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Mac 2012.

Aktiviti digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan bagi pelaburan semula

2. Aktiviti dan keluaran yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual ditentukan sebagai
aktiviti digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan bagi pelaburan semula.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan (Aktiviti Digalakkan dan Keluaran
Digalakkan bagi Pelaburan Semula) 2008 [P.U. (A) 210/2008] dibatalkan.

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS ACT 1986

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS (PROMOTED ACTIVITIES AND PROMOTED
PRODUCTS FOR REINVESTMENT) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4F of the Promotion of Investments
Act 1986 [ Act 327 ], the Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance,
makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as t he Promotion of Investments
(Promoted Activities and Promoted Products for Reinvestment) Order 2012.

  (2) This Order come into operation on  2 March 2012.

Promoted activities and promoted products for reinvestment
2. The activities and products listed in the Schedule are determined to be
promoted activities and promoted products for reinvestment.

Revocation
3.  The Promotion of Investments (Promoted Activities and Promoted Products
for Reinvestment) Order 2008 [P.U. (A) 210/2008] is revoked.
